title: macOS first run is blocked - missing Xcode Command Line Tools plus a dangling connector symlink
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-559 - Cross-platform first run: the verification trip and the Xcode CLT stop (consolidation sweep 2026-08-14). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-559/plan.md.

SIBLING: MPI-249 - verify a portable build on Linux + macOS. The Xcode CLT half here is what a macOS verification run hits first; both wait on the same missing Mac, so do them in one trip.

SPLIT 2026-08-05 by MPI-450 Gate C. The dangling @cubric/connector symlink half is FIXED AND SHIPPED (build-portable.mjs excludes the @cubric scope from the staged app tree, and a new assertNoDanglingSymlinks walks the WHOLE staged tree instead of only Electron.app - the scoping that let it through). The Xcode Command Line Tools half is what remains and is deliberately NOT in 1.4: a known-issue line ships instead, telling Mac users to run xcode-select --install first. Read brief.md before touching the remaining half - the tarball-instead-of-clone candidate is NOT established to remove the requirement, because the CLT also supplies clang. Original card text follows.

The LOCAL engine path (routes/engine.js _provisionUvEngine) calls ensureGit() (routes/gitProvision.js:172), and on macOS git is only available via the Xcode Command Line Tools. On a clean Mac they are NOT installed, so the very first Install press fails with "git is provided by the Xcode Command Line Tools, which are not installed". The user must run xcode-select --install, sit through a multi-minute Apple download, then press Retry. LIVE ON A RENTED M4 2026-07-31: reproduced exactly, on a box whose rental advertised "Xcode pre-installed" and did not have it. The error message itself is GOOD (names cause + remedy + full stack in app.log) - this card is about the requirement existing at all, not the reporting. WHY IT IS ASYMMETRIC: Windows ships a PREBUILT ComfyUI portable archive and never needs git; macOS/Linux provision via uv/comfy-cli which git-clones ComfyUI. CANDIDATE FIX: fetch the ComfyUI source tarball over HTTPS per tag instead of cloning. NOT YET ESTABLISHED: whether that removes the requirement, because CLT also supplies clang and any of the 23 universal deps lacking a prebuilt arm64 wheel would still need to compile. VERIFY THAT FIRST - if some dep compiles, killing git only moves the dialog later. Structural change to a shared provisioner: brief the user before writing code.

MERGED 2026-08-01: this card absorbs MPI-417 (macOS artifact ships a dangling @cubric/connector symlink; the documented xattr command errors for every user).
- MPI-417 - package.json declares a file: dependency on a sibling repo, ditto preserves the link, and it can never resolve on a user machine.
WHY ONE CARD: Both are hard stops on a clean Mac between download and first generation, both are found and fixed in the same sitting, and both are verified on the same trip to a Mac. Verification rides MPI-249 (blocked on hardware), but the fixes do not - the symlink half is a build-script change and the CLT half is a detect-and-guide change.
The absorbed card(s) are closed as done/rejected - not built, kept as the record - and their full original text stays on disk at tasks/<id>/.
